gob-project.project_overview: A collection of high-impact ad designs for GOBRANDING, a digital marketing agency. The objective was to create professional, trust-driven visuals for advertising campaigns, specifically engineered to engage B2B clients, SME owners,... seeking digital growth solutions.

tokyo-deli-project.project_overview: Bringing the essence of Japanese cuisine to the digital space through refined, 'Fresh & Authentic' visual storytelling. This project focuses on capturing the natural beauty of ingredients with a minimalist yet elegant layout and balancing traditional Japanese aesthetics with modern design.
